# Optional: called_barcodes — fallback cell list when no count matrix exists (e.g. Smart-seq2)
# Optional: count_matrix — STARsolo/CellRanger matrix dir; auto-discovered from BAM if omitted
# Optional: qc_barcodes — precomputed goodCells list (skips metric QC)
# Optional: cell_id — required for per-cell BAM platforms (Smart-seq2)
#   Multiple rows may share the same sample_id (e.g.
#   Each row is processed independently through alignment/validation.
#   Rows with the same sample_id are merged (samtools merge) before downstream steps.
